mutations.before:
`select campaign_id, ${TO_ISO} as updated_at
         from last_opened
        where org_id = $1 and user_id = $2`,
      [this.orgId, userId],
mutations.after:
`select campaign_id, ${TO_ISO} as updated_at
         from last_opened
        where org_id = $1 -- mutant: no user filter, so any user's pointer answers
        limit 1`,
      [this.orgId],
mutations.because: dropping the user_id filter from the pointer read hands every user in an org whichever pointer row sorts first, so one person's last-opened campaign is another's (D173: the pointer is per (org, user), which is what makes it follow them to another device)
command: two users in one org keep independent pointers
